title: A channel in a green organelle
hook: Locate this step in the cell-energy map.

knows: Eukaryotic organelles contain different internal compartments.
doesNotKnow: Chloroplast ATP synthase is embedded in the thylakoid membrane. Proton movement through it helps drive ATP formation.

misconception: Every step of a pathway occurs in the same compartment.
objective: Locate the stated process in a simplified organelle diagram.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: In chloroplasts, where is the ATP synthase that uses the light-driven proton gradient embedded? Chloroplast ATP synthase is embedded in the thylakoid membrane. Proton movement through it helps drive ATP formation.
Organelle shapes and membrane folds are schematic and not to scale.
Recall: In chloroplasts, what is the fluid space around thylakoids called? The stroma surrounds thylakoids inside the chloroplast.

recall.question: In chloroplasts, what is the fluid space around thylakoids called?
recall.why: The stroma surrounds thylakoids inside the chloroplast.
